proposals.reason: TGA finalized new classification rules and CDSS exemption clarifications applicable to MDSW targeting Australia.

card.t: TGA — Classification Rules & CDSS Exemptions Updated
card.x: Australia revised device classification criteria and clarified Clinical Decision Support System exemptions, in force immediately.

proposals.reason: SecNumCloud 3.2 entered into force by decree 12 Aug 2026, applicable to health data hosting providers in France.

card.x: SecNumCloud 3.2 reference framework now mandatory for cloud providers hosting health data in France; aligns with upcoming EU cloud regulation.

proposals.reason: ENISA published draft v0.4 technical opinion on AI-assisted software development and cybersecurity implications.

card.t: ENISA — AI-Assisted Dev Technical Opinion v0.4
card.x: Draft v0.4 addresses cybersecurity of AI-assisted software development; MDSW developers should review ahead of final publication.

proposals.reason: ANSM activated winter surveillance plan 2026-2027 covering Oct 2026 – Mar 2027 for essential devices and medicines.

card.x: Enhanced post-market surveillance for respiratory devices and diagnostics Oct 2026 – Mar 2027; availability declarations may be required.

proposals.reason: [REVIEW: description entierement reecrite — verifier que ce n'est pas un nouveau jalon qui devrait etre un add] UK government confirmed indefinite CE mark recognition on 21 Oct 2026; status moves from consultation to in-force.

card.t: UK — Indefinite CE Mark Recognition Confirmed
card.x: CE-marked EU devices permanently recognized in GB (England, Scotland, Wales); no UKCA requirement for EU manufacturers. NI continues EU rules.

proposals.reason: prEN 18229-3 (AI human oversight) entered final vote 22 Oct 2026, result expected 1 Jul 2027; aligns with AI Act Article 14.

card.t: prEN 18229-3 — AI Human Oversight Final Vote Begins
card.x: Final approval vote on human oversight requirements for AI systems (AI Act Article 14); result expected 1 Jul 2027, then harmonised standard.

proposals.reason: prEN 18283 public enquiry on AI bias management closes 24 Dec 2026, vote 3 Mar 2027; implements AI Act Article 10.

card.t: prEN 18283 — AI Bias Management Enquiry Closes
card.x: Public enquiry on bias identification and mitigation in AI systems ends 24 Dec 2026; final vote 3 Mar 2027. Key for high-risk MDSW.

proposals.reason: CLC/TC 62 published amendment A1:2026 to EN IEC 60601-2-28:2019 for X-ray tube assemblies; in force immediately.

card.x: Amendment A1:2026 sets safety and performance requirements for medical X-ray tube assemblies; effective immediately, no transition period.
